pattern: を余儀なくされる（をよぎなくされる）
purpose: Describe an unwanted change imposed by circumstances.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
N + を余儀なくされる
Flooding forced the residents to evacuate.
Material shortages forced a reduction in production.
An injury forced the athlete to retire.
formation: N + を余儀なくされる
restrictions: The subject undergoes a forced change, usually an action noun.
mistake: Passive される takes the affected party as subject.
